name: Vardhman Textiles Ltd
title: Vardhman Textiles Ltd - 502986 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Industry spinning capacity fell ~11-12m spindles to ~41-42m working as of the industry estimate, and yarn spreads rose to $0.90-0.95 from $0.60-0.65, though management gave no numeric Vardhman guidance.

utilisation.quote: home textiles and the garment exporter to the U.S.A., they are running almost 90%, 100% capacity utilization

capex.peers_comment: Industry expansion appears to be waiting for clarity on import policy; machinery orders are mainly modernisation, not expansion.
capex.quote: nobody is looking at a very big expansions to start immediately

triggers.label: Industry spindles 53m → ~41-42m working
triggers.quote: practically the working capacity today in India will not be more than 41, 42 million spindles as per the industry estimate

triggers.label: Yarn spread $0.60-0.65 → $0.90-0.95
triggers.quote: $0.90, $0.95 spread is available, which four months back was only about $0.60, $0.65 US cents

triggers.label: ~1,000 mills shut, consolidation
triggers.quote: almost 1,000 factories have gone shut down

triggers.label: US-bound garment utilisation 50-60% → 90-100%
